data.narrative:
Riverlane is a Series C quantum computing company founded by Steve Brierley that has raised $120M+ to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 3 public comparables (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

A stage-progression methodology was the only applicable triangulation approach. Using total raised ($120M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the subsequent stage yields $204M. A peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow quantum computing cohort; while 8 private peers exist sector-wide, none met the three-minimum threshold for same-stage or adjacent-stage filtering, making broader sectoral medians unreliable for precision valuation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $173M to $235M, with a median estimate of $204M. This range reflects conservative and expansive applications of the stage-progression multiplier. Key uncertainties include the lack of narrow-peer pricing data to validate or adjust the stage multiplier against recent quantum computing financings, and reliance on raised capital as a proxy for current post-money valuation. A post-Series C revaluation incorporating recent peer-market transactions or revenue/milestone data would reduce this range.
